title: UH-72 provides flooding assessment mission video
description: Uh-72 Lakota from the Mississippi National Guard providing an assessment mission for flood water monitoring following topical storm Florence over the Waccamaw River, Conway, South Carolina. Images include the Rt. 501 causeway Hesco barrier effectiveness, Sept. 24, 2018.
